info.name: Route API with Route Stops
info.description: Collection for testing Route APIs that now support creating and updating route stops

request.description: Create a new route with multiple stops
Create route without any stops initially
Get all routes with their associated stops (auto-sorted by orderIndex)
Get a specific route by ID with all its stops
Update a route and replace all its stops. Old stops are deleted, new stops are created.

body.raw:
{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Downtown Express Route - No Stops",
  "status": "Active",
  "driverId": 1,
  "description": "Route with no stops",
  "routeStops": []
}

request.description: Update route to have no stops (all stops will be deleted)
Update only the status of a route. Stops remain unchanged.
Delete a route. All associated route stops are also deleted due to cascade delete.
